title: Virtual environment and local Ollama model setup
description: These commands create an isolated Python virtual environment, install pinned Pydantic AI and FastMCP packages, and pull the two local Ollama models.

steps.description: Create and activate a virtual environment in .venv, then install pinned versions of pydantic-ai-slim (with openai and mcp extras), fastmcp, and pytest.
Pull qwen2.5:3b (the default tool-calling model for this tutorial) and llama3.2 (the general chat model used for comparison) into your local Ollama server.
